BrochureContent.Content:
***LAST REMAINING UNIT*** 

Fort View is an exceptional boutique development that elevates contemporary living within a refined and exclusive community. Crafted for professionals and young families, this distinguished development offers impeccably designed homes for discerning purchasers who value style, comfort, and location above all else. 

Showcasing exceptional craftsmanship, premium finishes, and impressive energy efficiency these premium homes enjoy breathtaking elevated views across the surrounding countryside of Ballinagh, while remaining just a short stroll from the village centre. Cavan town is conveniently located within a 15 minute drive. 

Extending to 209 sq. m., approx. the accommodation has been created to maximise natural light, space, and connection to its surroundings. At the centre of the home lies an expansive open-plan kitchen and living area, carefully created to enhance flow and usability. Clean lines, generous glazing, and open proportions create an elegant yet comfortable environment, perfectly suited to modern family life. A utility room, double bedroom, guest w.c. / shower room and entertainment / family room complete the ground floor accommodation. 

Upstairs there are a further three bedrooms, a generous family bathroom and the luxurious master suite featuring a private en-suite and walk-in wardrobe. 

Every element of these impeccably crafted homes has been carefully considered, resulting in homes that deliver architectural presence, superior craftsmanship and elevated living in a unique setting.
